equation_summary: Based applies a second-order Taylor feature map phi to q,k (external) so that exp(q.k) ≈ 1 + q.k + (q.k)^2/2, then runs normalized linear attention: numerator o = cumsum over phi(q)(phi(k)^T v), denominator z = sum of the feature-map attention row, output o/(z + 1e-6). The recurrent/chunk path uses explicit TaylorFeatureMap + chunk_linear_attn(normalize=True); the parallel path computes the implicit 1+x+x^2/2 kernel directly. There is no decay (G=I).
state_shape: [B,H,K,V] matrix (expanded feature-dim state); plus a [B,H,K_feat] denominator cumulative state
